Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，The location phrase should come before the action verb it modifies. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，装 cannot directly introduce an action in this meaning; 假装 + verb phrase expresses pretending to do that action. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is a completed move at a specific time in the past, so the action needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点状语应放在动作“玩”前面，“喜欢在墓地里玩”正确。
“装祭拜”搭配不当；“假装祭拜”可以正确表达假装进行祭拜。
这里叙述五岁时已经完成的一次搬家，应用完成体“搬了家”。
